## Purpose
This site is Mihail Mihaylov's professional portfolio. Use it to understand who Mihail is, what he builds, and how to contact him.

## Who is Mihail?
Mihail Mihaylov is a Solutions Architect specialising in custom tools and AI systems. Recent work includes production MCP servers, agentic workflows, and retrieval-augmented generation using vector search. His background spans full-stack engineering, automation, API-led integrations, and enterprise RPA. He is a Solutions Architect at Businessmap, and previously a Technical Solution Architect at Deloitte LLP UK.

## What to answer from this site
- Mihail's focus areas: custom tools and AI systems, including MCP servers, agentic workflows, and retrieval-augmented generation, plus solution architecture, automation, API-led integrations, and enterprise RPA
- High-level project overview (selected projects and outcomes)
- Availability: based in Sofia, working remotely across European and US-overlap hours
